body:
Concurrent runtime work superseded the previous release-source CI. This preserves that work, records the exact incoming source and cancelled run, and establishes a current source through the required PR checks and normal squash merge.

A byte comparison of 372 release-bound inputs confirms the module-key correction, release workflows, package qualification/publisher gates, tracked control fixtures, package/runtime catalog, lockfile and SDK pin retain their bytes. Incoming outcome-retention and test-environment/result changes remain intact and must pass full CI and governed release qualification.

The evidence retains separate bypass classifications for the earlier release push and the external concurrent push, plus the successful normal PR merge. Pinned commitlint accepted the exact full successor message. Only successful push CI for the resulting current main SHA allows manual release. Platform and Conversations pins, indexed gitlinks, prior observations and Story 16.1 runtime hold remain preserved.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Low Risk**
> Changes are limited to release-plan documentation and read-only governance evidence; no runtime, CI workflow, or release-gate code is altered.
> 
> **Overview**
> **Documents concurrent `main` movement during Module CLI release qualification and archives the GitHub/API evidence for that episode.**
> 
> The release plan gains a **Concurrent current-tip source confirmation** section: while CI for `36e7e485` was in flight, `main` moved to `0ade5ec2`, CI run `40181805558` was **cancelled** (not treated as green), and a separate push is recorded as **ruleset bypass**. It states that 372 release-bound inputs are unchanged for workflows, qualification, schema, lockfile, and SDK pin, while concurrent runtime/test-schema work must still be validated via full push CI before manual release.
> 
> Under `evidence/g4/module-configuration-key-release-20261025/`, the PR **adds** captured `gh`/`git` command metadata and JSON snapshots (cancelled run, activity, rule suites, post-cancellation `main` ref, byte-compatibility report, diff-hygiene checks, commitlint for the successor message, and related squash-merge records). **No application, workflow, or package source files are modified** in this diff—only docs and audit artifacts.
>
